requirement: A refused edit or undo records the refusal code in the ops signal, including the string error code the Claude Cowork engine sends

oracle.ref: PR #1494 (fix); fix evidence: Before this change every refused edit was recorded with refusal: null, because the engine sends error as a string and applyDoor read error.code
oracle.invariant: S1: X, unknown_action and Y. S2: null; then the code without control characters, at most 64 characters. S3: both rows keep refusal; site.edit still drops moment, site.undo keeps moment.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: the code is read from each of the three refusal shapes
an answer that names no code is null
a code is bounded and carries no control characters
a refused edit and a refused undo both keep their code through the signal field filter
